heading: Where the depth comes from.
education: MBA, IPADE Business School. BS Industrial Engineering, Universidad Iberoamericana.

roles.title: AI Engagement Manager (FDE, AI Builder)
roles.description: Run enterprise AI engagements across LATAM for RapidCanvas, an agentic AI platform that pairs autonomous agents with human experts to build custom enterprise applications. Own each engagement end to end: technical discovery with executives and data teams, working proofs of concept instead of slide decks, scoping and SOWs, then day-to-day delivery through rollout, with outcomes tracked at 30, 60, and 90 days. The bridge between what the platform can build and what the client actually needs.

roles.title: Partner
roles.description: Partner at the AI/product studio behind several joint builds shown on this site. Own client-facing scoping and engagement structuring (translating founder problems into the right build, not the most interesting one), plus delivery oversight on joint engagements. Recent: Service Core (finance integration layer), Mexico por el Clima (multi-module climate platform).

roles.title: Director of Operations
roles.description: Owned B2B P&L for the edtech arm of Mexico's leading higher-education group. Managed enterprise accounts worth $300K+ each (HSBC, Santander, Novartis, Accenture). Lifted B2C retention +20pts to 70%; cut opex 15% without sacrificing quality.

roles.title: LATAM Business Development Manager (founding team) → LATAM Head of Sales
roles.description: Led GTM across 5 LATAM countries. Built and managed a 12-person team (+25% sales/rep in two quarters). Owned a portfolio of 100+ clients and $15M+ in credit lines; +30% revenue/account through structured cross-sell. Contributed customer-data analysis and research to the Series C deck — ~$180M raised at a $2.1B valuation.

roles.title: Senior Consultant
roles.description: Market sizing and GTM strategy for fintech and payments clients across LATAM, EMEA, and the US. Researched and advised on 100+ fintechs.

roles.title: MBA Summer Associate, Operations
roles.description: Operations rotation during the IPADE MBA. Process work inside one of LATAM's largest banks — useful exposure to how scale and regulation shape execution at a different order of magnitude than startups.
